name: Skyrove
positioning: Autonomous drone inspections that turn towers, turbines, and tank farms into tidy reports — without sending a human up a ladder they'll regret.

hero.h1: Your inspectors deserve fewer near-death experiences.
hero.sub: Skyrove flies the asset, spots the crack, and writes the report before your team finishes their coffee. Enterprise-grade drone inspections, minus the harnesses and the hero mentality.

features.title: Flights that fly themselves
features.description: Pre-mapped autonomous missions across towers, turbines, and tank farms. Pilots optional, coffee mandatory, no PhD in aviation required.

features.title: Defects, caught mid-air
features.description: Our models flag corrosion, cracks, and loose bolts frame-by-frame, then rank them by how much they'll ruin your quarter if ignored.

features.title: Reports nobody has to write
features.description: Every flight becomes an annotated, audit-ready PDF with GPS-tagged findings. The kind your integrity engineer stops dreading.

features.title: Compliance that behaves
features.description: Findings map to your inspection intervals and regulatory codes, so audits become a boring formality instead of a fire drill.

features.title: One fleet, one dashboard
features.description: Track every drone, site, and open defect from a single view. Filter by severity, asset, or the site manager who keeps calling.

features.title: Trends before they trend
features.description: Compare inspections over time to see which assets are quietly falling apart. Fix them on your schedule, not the failure's.

testimonials.quote: We used to rope-access every turbine blade twice a year. Now Skyrove flies them monthly and I get a defect ledger instead of a stack of clipboard photos. My rope crew is thrilled to be doing literally anything else.
testimonials.name: Marta Vandeveld

testimonials.quote: The reports are the whole thing. Our old telecom tower inspections took nine days to reach my inbox. Skyrove has them signed, tagged, and audit-ready before I've closed the work order.
testimonials.name: Devin Osei

testimonials.quote: Refinery inspections are where optimism goes to die. Skyrove flagged a corrosion spot on a flare stack we'd have missed until it was expensive. Paid for the year in one flight.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For teams testing the theory that drones beat ladders.
features: Pay only for minutes actually flown

pricing.blurb: For operations running regular inspections across many assets.
features: Volume discounts that kick in automatically

features: Custom defect models for your assets

homepage.footerBlurb: Skyrove flies your infrastructure so your people don't have to. Fewer ladders, faster reports, and inspections that actually finish on time.
